attempt_budget_exhausted.verdict: the new value is CORRECT; wave 6 is right and W2-QA's expectation was wrong
attempt_budget_exhausted.contract_status: the field appears NOWHERE in contracts/. It is an internal stage metric, so the question was argued rather than looked up.
attempt_budget_exhausted.argument: Under the old definition the field was exactly attempts >= attempt_budget - a pure function of two scalars already persisted on the same row - so it carried no information while poisoning any query counting exhausted budgets with runs that had published. Under the new definition it encodes the last attempt's outcome, which is NOT recoverable from the row: retried_on_error_code names the error that caused a retry, not the final outcome. The new definition is the only one under which persisting the field is justified.
